b:
Vivekananda,
you are asleep

A little different
from ordinary days:
you forgot
to draw back in
the breath
you let out!

Perhaps
the trees
you planted
snatched it
away

O diamond from Balachander's workshop!
Where will I look for rationalist cinema now?

Did you think,
"I have given the Tamil world enough"?

Would anyone say
they have had enough of sweet honey?

Like Dasaratha,
because of your longing,
today
he too
has called
you to him

All right,
go,
go quickly
to see your son

And come back
here with him
soon

Until then
the throne called Vivek
will stay empty
note: Written for the Tamil actor and comedian Vivek (1961–2021), whose real name was Vivekanandan. He was mentored by the director K. Balachander, was known for rationalist humour, and led a campaign to plant millions of trees. He died suddenly of a heart attack; his young son had died in 2015. In the Ramayana, King Dasaratha dies of grief, longing for his son Rama.
